continuity.explanation: Continuity metrics describe how long a condition has persisted; they do not forecast future returns.

etf_flow.note: cum_depth_pct is cumulative net redemption relative to AUM at the cycle start; >100% does not imply holdings sold more than once. Diffusion metrics are not yet verified and are reported as DATA_MISSING rather than zero.

regime.note: Regime labels describe the current 120-trading-day drawdown state only; DECLINE does not imply the decline will continue.
